personality_one_liner: A professional, command-center financial terminal that prioritizes rapid data scanning, stark contrast, and operational clarity over decorative softness.

spacing.rule: Dense but structured. Use generous vertical spacing between distinct modules (cards) but tight spacing within data rows to optimize for scannability.

do's: Use solid tonal separation (surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary) to create depth on data-dense screens.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism on this app. Dark-first utility requires maximum clarity and performance, especially for live terminal data.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A command-center dashboard summarizing the selected market, quick AI analysis access, and portfolio/recent trends.

states.loading: Skeleton rows for market data; a subtle pulse on the main chart area.
states.empty: No recent analyses - prompt to 'Upload first chart' with a brandPrimary CTA.
states.error: Data fetch failed - high-contrast text 'Connection Lost' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Header: Brand logo + User profile. Hero: Selected Market card (Asset, huge live price using display font, 24h change with semantic color, sparkline). Main CTA: Large brand-tinted card 'New AI Analysis' pinned to thumb zone or below hero. Below: 'Recent Analyses' horizontal scroll or stacked list.

screens.name: AI_Analysis
screens.purpose: Focused input screen to capture or select a chart, choose asset/timeframe, and trigger AI processing.

states.loading: Scanning animation over the uploaded chart, analyzing patterns.
states.empty: Empty state illustration of a chart placeholder with 'Upload from Gallery' or 'Take Photo'.
states.error: Upload failed or invalid image - clear error toast.

screens.layout: Top: Chart preview area (if uploaded) or empty upload zone with borderStrong dashed line. Form: Asset selector (dropdown/sheet), Timeframe segmented control (15m, 1H, 4H, 1D). Bottom: Sticky primary CTA 'Analyze Chart'.

screens.name: Markets
screens.purpose: Live list of supported crypto assets providing quick glanceable price action.

states.loading: Sequential skeleton loaders for list items.
states.empty: No markets found (should not happen, fallback to offline cached data).
states.error: Failed to sync live prices - red warning banner at top.

screens.layout: Search/Filter bar pinned at top. List of assets: Left side (Asset Logo PNG + Ticker), Right side (Live Price + 24h % badge in success/error colors). Use rigid grids and monospace alignment for all numbers.

screens.name: News
screens.purpose: Feed of crypto news headlines labeled with AI sentiment.
screens.layout: Vertical list of news cards. Each card: Title, timestamp, and a Sentiment Badge (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral) aligned right. Text density should be high.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Archive of past user chart analyses.

states.empty: Abstract dark void illustration + 'No past analyses yet.'

screens.layout: List of history cards. Each card displays a thumbnail of the chart (with vertical gradient scrim), asset/timeframe, date, and the final AI conclusion badge. Standard vertical scroll.

screens.name: Result
screens.purpose: The core analytical output, breaking down the AI's reasoning, targets, and scenarios with strict uncertainty disclaimers.
screens.layout: Top: Full-width Hero image of the uploaded chart with gradient scrim (top-to-bottom) and AI-drawn annotations (bounding boxes/arrows if any). Beneath chart: Asset Ticker & Timeframe. Section 1: Bullish/Bearish Score Gauge (split bar). Section 2: 'Trade Scenarios' - segmented control or stacked cards (Bullish, Bearish, Neutral) showing Entry Zone, Targets (T1, T2), Invalidation levels, and Risk/Reward ratio. Section 3: Detected Patterns (brandTertiary chips). Section 4: News Sentiment & Technical Indicators (grid). Sticky footer: 'Not Financial Advice' warning.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility (Personality 7) guidelines. Do not add blur, glassmorphism, or soft shadows to this app. Use solid tonal separation (surface, surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary) to create visual hierarchy.

Use Rajdhani for all large metrics, live prices, and key headings. Ensure all financial numbers (prices, percentages) use a monospace variant or are aligned as tabular data to avoid layout shifting on live ticks.

BANNED COLORS: All blues (including navy, azure, cobalt), purples, indigos. Adhere strictly to the defined palette of obsidian/charcoal bases with an Amber brand primary. Only use Green (success) and Red (error) for strict semantic meaning (bullish/bearish).
On the Result screen, visually delineate uncertainty. Ensure the 'Not Financial Advice' warning is sticky or heavily highlighted at the bottom of the analytical readout.
When displaying asset logos (BTC, ETH, SOL), use the provided URLs or fetch transparent PNGs if missing. Do not use generic initials for assets unless a real logo is absolutely unavailable.
Implement a strict gradient scrim pattern (transparent -> 70%+ surfaceInverse) whenever text sits over the chart images on the Result screen or History thumbnails.
